changes.title: Footstool jump heights now match behavior from before v3.2
Adjusted airdodge behavior so waveland distances closely match their distances from before v3.2
Ledge releases now apply gravity starting on frame 1, matching Melee behavior
Empty landing animations can now enter teeter, matching Melee behavior
Windboxes ignore knockback stacking once again

moves.title: Up Special (Fire Bird)
changes: Vertical momentum reset frame 2 > 1, matching Melee behavior

moves.title: Up Special (Fire Fox)
changes: Vertical momentum reset frame 2 > 1, matching Melee behavior

moves.title: Side Special (Flame Choke)
changes: Fixed an issue from v3.2 where characters grabbed could occasionally execute a grounded tech earlier than intended

moves.title: Neutral Special (Ice Shot)
changes: Can no longer be teeter-canceled

moves.title: Up Special (Vine Whip)
changes: Landing lag after a forced reel-in jump can once again be edge-canceled
This was an indirect change from v3.2 physics changes, but wasn’t included in the last changelog

moves.title: Bug Fixes
changes: Sonic’s copy ability (Homing Attack) can now turn around on-hit
Falco’s copy ability (Blaster) projectiles now use electric hit effect

moves.title: Attributes
changes: Jump initial Y-velocity 2.95 > 3.05, removing obstructively common no-impact landings on specific stages

moves.title: Bug Fixes
changes: Fixed additional cases where special move resources failed to refresh properly during certain grounded actions

moves.title: Down Special (PSI Magnet)
changes: Vertical momentum now resets on frame 1 to compensate for v3.2 physics changes

moves.title: Bug Fixes
changes: Fixed an issue from v3.2 where Z-Air was unaffected by double-jump canceling

moves.title: Attributes
changes: Adjusted horizontal momentum during double-jump canceled aerials, to compensate for v3.2 physics changes

moves.title: Up Special (Shield Bash)
changes: Fixed an issue from v3.2 where Pit could land earlier than intended after reaching the peak height

moves.title: Bug Fixes
changes: Fixed additional cases where special move resources failed to refresh properly during certain grounded actions

moves.title: Turnaround Grab
changes: Active frames adjusted from 11-13, 16-17 > 11-17

moves.title: Up Special (Fire Wolf)
changes: Vertical momentum reset frame 2 > 1, matching changes given to Fox & Falco

changes.title: Fixed a set of issues from v3.2 regarding Din’s Fire incorrectly accessing repurposed data, thus fixing various bugs including:
changes: Dormant hitbox data (dating back to Project M) being able to re-activate under certain conditions
The fireball projectile incorrectly rebounding to Zelda even after she took damage
Visual effects on Zelda’s hand vanishing prematurely while the fireball was still homing toward her
Edge-canceling Din’s Fire causing Zelda to enter an uninterruptible hairflip animation mid-air

moves.title: Up Special (Plasma Wire) / Side Special (Plasma Whip)
changes: Landing lag after a forced reel-in jump can once again be edge-canceled
This was an indirect change from v3.2 physics changes, but wasn’t included in the last changelog

changes.title: Base stage
changes: Normalized camera limits
The upper camera limit is now set to 60 units from the blastzone, matching PM 3.6
Aligned left and right camera limits (previously differed by 5 units)

changes.title: Base stage
changes: Fixed corrupted floor collisions that affected Mewtwo horizontal teleport behavior
Corrected platform sizes and heights to be totally symmetric where they were previously misaligned by 0.0001 units

moves.title: Characters
changes: Adjusted dust visual effects on Captain Falcon’s skid animation
Updated Waddles & Gordo visuals for Dedede’s Z-alt hidden costume (Crystal Shards Dedede)
Updated character shadows for Tuxedo Snake and Yoshi’s Z-alt hidden costume (Boshi)

moves.title: Gameplay

changes.title: Fixed various issues related to v3.2 physics behavior changes
changes: Wavedashing off the exact edge of a platform no longer results in an airdodge
Wavedashing straight down while in teeter no longer leads to an instant landing
Fixed an error related to airtime calculations for character collisions (ECBs), notably affecting multi-shine timings
Pressing C-stick down at the ledge with certain control schemes no longer unintentionally causes a fastfall
Fixed grab pummels improperly allowing characters to break out of grabs after the first pummel of a match, due to the pummel animation not locking out as intended
Fixed a rare issue where upon grabbing the ledge with certain moves, characters could briefly appear in the center of the stage
Fixed an issue in Stamina mode where characters grabbed across a stage boundary would rapidly lose HP

changes.title: Adjusted Wii Remote control handling, allowing for smoother movement and full run speeds
changes: Longstanding problems regarding interactions with Subspace Emissary doors have also been fixed
Fixed a Brawl issue where shrinking effects (e.g. Poison Mushroom in Mini Special Versus) would not stack correctly
Characters can no longer enter the teeter state while holding an Assist Trophy

moves.title: Characters
changes: Fixed an issue from v3.2 where Link’s double-jump sound effect was muted
Corrected metal mode appearance for the Ice Climbers’ bear costumes and Jigglypuff's green picnicker hat costume
Fixed Zelda’s standard costumes failing to display proper glow effects during certain moves
Fixed some cases where tether reel-in animations could briefly appear misaligned with the ledge
Fixed minor visual errors on Zelda’s Z-alt hidden costume (Young Zelda)

moves.title: Wii Launcher
changes: Enhanced USB detection for auto loading
Improved settings for when PAL video modes are forced
Fixed auto-booting from Priiloader
Added error message for missing arguments

moves.title: Other
changes: Fixed a crash from v3.2 caused by pressing the Home button on a Wii remote
Fixed a crash from v3.2 caused by Alloy behavior in Multi-Man Smash
Fixed a crash from v3.2 caused by a background animation on the Fourside R-alt stage
Fixed an issue from v3.2 where enabling Team Battle after a match could set characters to non-team costumes
Fixed an issue from v3.2 where the 1/2x speed setting in Training Mode incorrectly set the game speed to 2x
Fixed a file loading issue when installed from macOS
Fixed SDXC card support
Added experimental SDUC card support
Other file optimizations made, totaling over 500 KB in file size reductions
